name: Sewing Machine Operator
description: Operates industrial sewing machines to join pieces of fabric or garment parts. Requires basic hand-eye coordination and sitting for long periods.

name: Solar Panel Installation Technician
description: Installs and maintains solar panels on rooftops. Requires physical fitness and ability to work outdoors and at heights.

name: Organic Grower
description: Cultivates organic crops using natural farming methods. Suitable for individuals with access to land or seeking self-employment in agriculture.

name: Beauty Therapist
description: Provides basic beauty, skincare, and grooming services. Highly suitable for individuals seeking self-employment or local salon work.
